sentences.text:
cancelling the bail of the petitioner, is under challenge in this petition filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C.
2.

The petitioner faces prosecution for the commission of offences under Sections 419, 468, 420,
465 and 471 IPC read with Section 34 IPC, in Crime No.345/2016 of Perumpadappu Police Station.

The Final Report in the said case had been filed by the Investigating Officer, and the case is now pending before the learned Magistrate as CC No.24/2020.
3.

While allowing the Bail Application filed by the petitioner before this Court as B.A No.844/2017,
this Court directed in the order dated 24.03.2017, that the petitioner has to surrender his passport before the learned Magistrate within 5 days of his release.
The bail granted to the petitioner was cancelled for the reason that the petitioner did not surrender his passport in compliance with the aforesaid condition.
4. In the present petition, the petitioner would contend that his failure to surrender passport before the Trial Court, was not deliberate.

According to the petitioner, a communication gap with the counsel, who 2025:KER:31512 moved the Bail Application for him before this Court, was the reason why he could not comply with the aforesaid condition imposed by this Court.

5. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor representing the State of Kerala.
6.

The learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner is ready to surrender before the Trial Court, and to submit his passport in compliance with the bail condition imposed by this Court, on any day as suggested by this Court.
It is further submitted that the petitioner is ready to cooperate with the trial, and that he will appear before the Trial Court on all occasions when his presence is required.

7. Having regard to the aforesaid submission of the learned counsel for the petitioner, and also the facts and circumstances of the case, I deem it appropriate to dispose of this petition with the following directions.

i) The petitioner shall surrender before the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court,
Ponnani, within a period of 30 days from today and surrender his passport before the said court.
ii) If the petitioner moves a Bail Application at the time of such surrender, the learned Magistrate shall allow the same, subject to appropriate conditions.
